entry.title: Stretch a band between pegs
entry.summary: Davies describes a pegboard and elastic bands for an older toddler to stretch and explore with adult supervision. A pattern can emerge, but copying a design is optional.
entry.cue: Your child is interested in stretching a band and hooking it over a peg.
detail: The illustrated example begins with stretching elastic bands over pegs and is labeled from around 2 years. Older children may use the same material to make patterns.
Show the movement slowly if help is wanted, then leave the arrangement to the child. This is one possible hand activity, not equipment every family needs. Small parts require supervision.
